faq.q: What is the 2027 numerology report price in India?
faq.a: The Astro-Numero Blend is ₹599 (was ₹856) and the Classics is ₹499 (was ₹713), with the 30% Diwali offer until 10 November. Outside India they are US$30 and US$20.

faq.q: What is the difference between Astro-Numero Blend and Classics?
faq.a: Classics includes 10 parameters, centred on your month-by-month action plan, yantra, mantra, remedies and space energy shift. Astro-Numero Blend includes the same 10 plus Transit and Varshaphal, and Dasha, making 12. Both include the 10-year life graph, all twelve months of 2027 and a personally recorded voice note. The Blend also needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Is this a generic yearly horoscope?
faq.a: No. Your Personal Year, Mulank, Lo Shu grid and Name Number come from your own date of birth and name, and Chapter 1 is written for your exact Personal Year and sun sign combination. Two people rarely get the same report.

faq.q: I don't know my time of birth. Can I still get it?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Classics. It is built from your date of birth and your name, so your birth time is not needed. The Astro-Numero Blend needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Is the 2027 numerology report a PDF, and when will I receive it?
faq.a: Yes. Your 2027 numerology report PDF arrives on your WhatsApp within 24 hours of payment. Inside is a QR code that opens a 30 to 60 second voice note from Shashank about your year.

faq.q: What is a 2027 astro numero report?
faq.a: It is a report that reads numerology and astrology together. Our 2027 astro numero report is the Astro-Numero Blend: your numbers read alongside your birth chart, which is why it needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Does it include a 2027 Lo Shu grid report?
faq.a: Yes. Every report has a 2027 Lo Shu grid report page: your date of birth plotted on the grid with your destiny number added and your 2027 Personal Year marked.

faq.q: Are bracelets included in the price?
faq.a: Your individual assessment includes yantra, mantra and bracelet recommendations. A physical bracelet is purchased separately. Ask us on WhatsApp about your recommendation before choosing one.

faq.q: How does the elemental assessment relate to the Lo Shu grid?
faq.a: Our elemental assessment is derived from the Lo Shu grid and interpreted for your individual chart. It is explained within your report; different numerology and five-element traditions should not be assumed to use an identical mapping.

faq.q: Is this a lifetime report or an annual forecast?
faq.a: It is primarily your 2027 annual forecast. Both versions also include a 10-year life graph and Pinnacles for longer-term context, plus a month-by-month action plan for 2027.

faq.q: Is the voice note personally recorded?
faq.a: Yes. Shashank personally records your voice note for you. It is a bonus with both reports, accessed through the QR code in your PDF.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: Buy your 2027 numerology report online on this page by UPI, card or netbanking. If you would like to talk first, message us on WhatsApp and pay from there.

faq.q: What if my report does not arrive?
faq.a: If your report has not reached you within 24 hours of payment, message us on WhatsApp with your payment reference. We send it straight away, or refund you in full if we cannot deliver it. The refund and delivery policy has the details.

faq.q: Can I order for my family or more than one person?
faq.a: Each order on this page is for one person, because each personalized 2027 numerology report is built from one date of birth. For two or more people, message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it.

faq.q: How do I choose the best 2027 numerology report?
faq.a: Look for one built from your own date of birth and name rather than your sun sign alone, that shows how each number is worked out, reads every month of 2027 and tells you who prepared it. A detailed numerology report for 2027 should also give remedies you can act on.

faq.q: Is there a free 2027 numerology report?
faq.a: The Personal Year calculator on this page is free and tells you the number your year is read through. The full report, with every month, your dates, Lo Shu grid and voice note, is paid. You can also read free 2027 numerology predictions on our blog.

faq.q: Does it replace a full birth chart consultation?
faq.a: No. Transit, Varshaphal and Dasha are included in Astro-Numero Blend, while Classics has the other 10 parameters. Both are annual 2027 reports. For a live discussion of your birth chart, book a separate online astrology consultation with Shashank, booked on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you offer live astrology and numerology consultations?
faq.a: Yes, as separate sessions, each booked on WhatsApp. The online astrology consultation is ₹3,699 and lasts strictly 40 to 45 minutes on Google Meet. The online numerology consultation is ₹555 for one service you choose, such as your Lo Shu grid, name, mobile number, bank account number or PIN alignment, in 20 minutes on Google Meet. The muhurat selection consultation is ₹1,269 and gives auspicious dates and times for an event such as an exam application, a launch, a property purchase or a registration. These fees are for clients in India only.

faq.q: Are there free numerology calculators?
faq.a: Yes. Thirteen free calculators, from Life Path and the Lo Shu grid to mobile, house and vehicle numbers, are on the numerology calculators page. They use Chaldean (Cheiro) letter values and run in your browser.

faq.q: Who is Shashank Agrawal?
faq.a: Shashank Agrawal is a Raipur-based Vedic astrologer and numerologist with more than six years of practice and the author of Numbers & Navgraha: Untold Secret of Numerology. Read about Shashank or about his work as a Vedic astrologer in Raipur.

faq.q: Why is phase one limited to 50 reports?
faq.a: Every report is prepared for one person by Shashank and his team. Phase one takes 50 reports and closes on 10 November.
